column1: # mapping_set_description: The classes of the Greek Order of the Redeemer and the degrees of the Filiki Etaireia placed under the generic chivalric grades and craft-style degrees.

column8: The lowest class; the generic ladder has no cross, and the knight is the nearest entry grade.
The second class, between the Silver Cross and the Commander.
The Anoteros Taxiarchis, between the Commander and the Grand Cross.
The first degree, entered by the small oath.
The second degree, between the sworn brother and the priest.
The third degree, which initiated others and knew the aim of the society.
The fourth and highest degree, held by the leaders.
